incident.summary: The deliberation selector existed and passed unit tests, but host/session maintenance could still promote a first-plausible architecture without first applying the selector. This allowed UAOS to be treated as a mandatory business gateway and left stale same-task-id Financial semantics in ENTRYPOINT and later stale bootstrap/readiness authority after narrower files were corrected.

root_cause: Deliberation was implemented as a pure selector but not made a fail-closed pre-mutation/pre-promotion host admission rule for material architecture/governance changes.
Closure verification was local to edited files/tests and did not require an authority-wide contradiction scan across every current surface encoding the changed semantic.
The parent/child relationship was conflated with mandatory request routing; parent governance was incorrectly allowed to imply parent mediation of normal child business execution.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: production ENTRYPOINT retained stale same-task-id Financial rule after prior closure
fresh-chat bootstrap pointer retained mandatory-UAOS-routing wording
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: registered child Agents must be independently usable work planes while UAOS remains the parent control/governance plane
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected assumption: parent authority implies mandatory runtime/business gateway
rejected assumption: common capability inheritance implies parent ownership of child business identity/state
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: Erlang/OTP supervisor versus child worker separation
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: mandatory parent proxy creates single-point coupling and contradicts domain-owned business authority
parent-created shared business identity caused the observed Financial coupling and authority drift
INDEPENDENT_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE: GitHub hosted full CI run 38579600772 PASS
GitHub hosted live-integration run 38579600785 PASS for PostgreSQL/DBOS/crash-recovery/S3 protocol

external_architecture_evidence.property_borrowed: control plane manages cluster/workload infrastructure while worker nodes run application workloads; management does not imply every application request is proxied by the control plane
external_architecture_evidence.fit: supports UAOS as governance/control plane with direct domain work-plane execution
external_architecture_evidence.misfit: UAOS is conversational governance, not a Kubernetes scheduler; no process/network mechanics are copied

external_architecture_evidence.property_borrowed: supervisor starts/stops/monitors child processes while workers retain their own execution role
external_architecture_evidence.fit: supports parent supervision/upcall without parent becoming the child's normal message proxy
external_architecture_evidence.misfit: no OTP restart tree or process semantics are introduced

changes: Freeze v1.5 direct-child-session, identity-boundary, cognitive-admission and authority-wide-closure requirements.
Correct ENTRYPOINT, session policy, common capabilities and fresh-chat pointer so selecting a registered child activates that child directly as current Agent/work plane.
Make adaptive deliberation a fail-closed material-change admission contract and add executable require_deliberation_admission evidence checks.
Require authority-wide contradiction scan before evolution closure.
Correct readiness from Financial 0.8.2/same-ID semantics to Financial 0.8.3/domain-owned identity semantics.
Add CI architecture regressions for parent-gateway, same-ID, stale bootstrap/readiness and deliberation-bypass failures.

details: A temporary noop file was accidentally written directly to main through the raw GitHub connector and immediately reverted.
The initial evolution record was also created directly on main before the candidate branch was established rather than through the intended CAS promotion path.
maintenance_process_deviation.impact: No child business authority or production runtime behavior was overwritten; the noop was removed and the evolution record is intended durable audit state.
maintenance_process_deviation.preventive_link: The incident reinforces the existing host-hardening limitation: Python ActionCoordinator/deliberation gates cannot physically intercept raw native connector writes; policy/CI improve logical admission but GitHub rulesets or tool mediation are still required for complete physical enforcement.

acceptance: registered child can be activated directly in a fresh chat without a persistent UAOS business proxy
no authoritative Financial same-ID or parent-created-article-identity rule remains
triggered material changes fail closed when required deliberation evidence is absent
authority-wide scan is required before RESOLVED
final candidate full CI and live integration pass
post-promotion main CI passes before status becomes RESOLVED
